text: A small sphere of mass 0.4 kg moves with constant speed 1.5 m s in a horizontal circle inside a
smooth fixed hollow cylinder of diameter 0.6 m. The axis of the cylinder is vertical, and the sphere is
in contact with both the horizontal base and the vertical curved surface of the cylinder.
A uniform semicircular lamina of radius 0.25 m has diameter AB. It is freely suspended at A from a
fixed point and hangs in equilibrium.
